joel: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem 3: I sketched a tight remediation cadence in the tracker: https://tiny.redwood/authz-cadence. Core asks: who owns verification, rotation, and runbook edits?
mira: I will own verification + alerts (row A). ETA Tue next week. Will add example Splunk filter and alert thresholds.
chen: I can own key/service token rotation (row B). Plan: KMS dual-version rollout + CI token purge. ETA 10 business days.
sam: Ill take runbook updates and the oncall escalation path (row C). Will add step for marking tickets `blocking` and runbook checklists.
runbook-bot: Created tasks: PM-5333 (verify-logs), PM-5334 (rotate-keys), PM-5335 (runbook-update). Links posted to tracker.
joel: couple quick items: (1) add a "legacy_flag" for tokens that need migration, (2) attach compliance tags GDPR/CCPA before closing tickets.
mira: Added a sample query to PM-5333: `event=token_validation result=fail | stats count by service` and set provisional spike threshold 0.5% over 5m.
chen: Uploaded KMS map to PM-5334. Question: rotate immediately or wait for maintenance window? Security suggests within 7 days unless it blocks prod flows.
sam: I'll add escalation flow to PM-5335 and set an automated check that marks PM tickets `blocking` if customer auth errors > 0.1% (measured by failed requests).
ops-bot: Weekly checkpoint scheduled for PM-5333 & PM-5334 every Wed 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
joel: Please update tracker when you make changes and add PR links in comments. If anything affects customers, ping #eng-oncall immediately. Meeting Thu 11:00 PT to review blockers. :thumbsup:
